items.correct: Downhill from source to mouth, in any compass direction.
items.random_wrong: From the sea up to their source.
items.why: Gravity makes rivers flow downhill to the sea, whatever direction that is.

items.q: What is the difference between erosion and deposition?
items.correct: Erosion wears away and moves material; deposition drops it.
items.why: Rivers and coasts erode, transport, then deposit material to shape landforms.

items.q: Why do waves deposit material to build beaches?
items.correct: When waves lose energy they drop the sediment they carry.
items.misconception: Beaches grow because the sea creates new sand from water.
items.why: Constructive waves with low energy deposit sediment, building up beaches.
